scope: Purification of OneStrep-Asf1a/b complexes for mass spectrometry analysis from cytosolic and nuclear extracts was performed essentially as described using high-stringency washes

complexes were isolated under low-stringency conditions (buffer A) from whole cell extracts. Prior to elution from the FLAG M2 beads, e-Asf1a wt and 4D complexes were mixed 1:1. Eluted proteins were run on SDS-PAGE, excised from the gel and subjected to LC-MS/MS.

For identification of TLK1 phospho-sites in Asf1 (a and b) by mass spectrometry, the kinase reaction contained 50 μM ATP, 6μg of recombinant Asf1 (a or b) and myc-TLK1 (2μg). Reaction products were resolved on a 15 % SDS-PAGE gel and stained with Coomassie Blue. Slow-migrating bands were cut and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
